items.name: Try Mitti attar
items.about: The smell of the first rain on dry earth, captured from baked clay.
howToSteps: Visit an attar shop or ask for a sample. Most let you smell first.
Dab a tiny amount on your wrist with the glass stick; attars are oil and very strong.
Smell it again after an hour. Attars change slowly on skin.

metadata.How it's made: Baked clay distilled into sandalwood oil in Kannauj.
metadata.Tradition: Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh and across India
